products.name: Prep Shortage Recovery
products.product: A focused restaurant prep shortage tracking workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent restaurants and small multi-location restaurant groups
products.problem: A missed prep item is often announced verbally, but quantity, affected menu items, substitute decision, owner, and recovery time are not visible across kitchen and management.
products.valueProposition: Turns restaurant prep shortage tracking into a visible operating queue so every service-impacting prep shortage has a quantified gap, approved response, owner, and communicated menu consequence.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets restaurant prep shortage, kitchen prep tracker, restaurant par list exception, and prep recovery workflow searches.

products.name: Menu Availability Publisher
products.product: A focused restaurant 86 list and menu availability tracking workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent restaurants and small multi-location restaurant groups
products.problem: When an item or modifier sells out, staff may update one POS screen but miss online ordering, third-party channels, service teams, or the later un-86 decision.
products.valueProposition: Turns restaurant 86 list and menu availability tracking into a visible operating queue so every availability change is approved, published to all intended channels, acknowledged by service staff, and reversed only after supply is verified.
products.topic: restaurant 86 list and menu availability tracking
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets restaurant 86 list, menu item availability software, restaurant sold out tracking, and POS item out of stock searches.

products.name: Manager Shift Handoff
